cards.title: Google Launches Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: 2.6% WER Non-Streaming, 70% Latency Improvement over Chirp 3
cards.why_it_matters: As an AI/ML engineer building voice agents or multimodal pipelines, this is a significant new API option with measurable accuracy and latency benchmarks worth tracking against competing STT services.
cards.summary: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe achieves 4.0% WER (streaming) and 2.6% WER (non-streaming) per Artificial Analysis benchmarks, and improves time-to-final-transcription by 70% over Chirp 3. Available via Live API (sub-second streaming) and Interactions API (speaker attribution, word-level timestamps). Supports 85+ languages, custom vocabulary, and up to 3-speaker diarization. Also powers Gboard's Rambler and Gemini macOS app.

cards.title: Papers with Code Hybrid Search: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B + pgvector + RRF over 110K Papers
cards.why_it_matters: A clean real-world case study of hybrid retrieval architecture — versioned embeddings, offline/online compute split, graceful degradation — directly relevant to any engineer building production RAG or search systems.
cards.summary: Papers with Code's search combines PostgreSQL full-text search with pgvector dense embeddings (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, 256-dim MRL vectors), fused via reciprocal rank fusion. Offline corpus embedding runs as Hugging Face Jobs; live query embedding uses a protected Inference Endpoint with full-text fallback on cold start. The system covers 110,000+ papers with a strictly versioned embedding contract to prevent silent drift.

cards.title: VBVR-Pro: Closed-Loop Benchmark for Training MLLMs to Reason Natively Through Visual Generation
cards.why_it_matters: For researchers working on agents, world models, or multimodal reasoning, this is a rare benchmark that makes visual-generative reasoning trainable with verifiable RL rewards rather than VLM-as-judge.
cards.summary: VBVR-Pro provides 300 procedurally generated tasks where visual states (images/video) are the reasoning substrate. It includes deterministic reward scorers that outperform VLM-as-judge for RL training, and supports controlled comparison across 30+ image, video, and interleaved generators. Video generation leads on spatiotemporal tracking; interleaved generation is compute-efficient. Models transfer to seven external benchmarks including RISE-Video and MME-CoF-Pro.

cards.title: Visual Dependence-Aware Framework Tackles Cross-Modal Forgetting in Unsupervised Continual MLLM Post-Training
cards.why_it_matters: Continual post-training of deployed MLLMs on unlabeled streaming data is an under-studied but practically critical problem; this work's framing of visual dependence distortion as a forgetting signal is a technically novel angle.
cards.summary: VDA addresses Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training by treating token-level visual dependence (VD) as a diagnostic signal. Visually Constrained Optimal Transport (VC-OT) uses region-aware ground cost and dependence-stratified penalties to prevent cross-modal forgetting. Visually Modulated Adaptation (VMA) exploits VD heterogeneity to drive new-task plasticity. The framework targets stability-plasticity balance without labeled data.

cards.title: MyoMechanix: 7,500-Sample Multimodal AQA Benchmark Pairing sEMG, 3D Pose, and RGB for Biomechanical Coaching
cards.why_it_matters: For researchers in Physical AI, embodied agents, or multimodal sensing, this is a large structured benchmark combining physiological signals with vision for fine-grained action quality assessment — a relatively rare combination.
cards.summary: MyoMechanix contains 7,500+ samples across 20 weight-loaded actions from 38 subjects, with synchronized multiview RGB, 3D pose, sEMG, and additional physiological signals. A Fitness Knowledge Graph structures expert annotations into action phases, errors, and corrective feedback. The CUBIST engine does compositional decomposition-analysis-recomposition for error attribution. New tasks include Video2EMG, suggesting video can substitute costly EMG sensing.

cards.title: Autonomous AI Agent Designs Wireless Power Control ML Algorithms: Reaches 99.5% of MM Reference in 81 Unattended Experiments
cards.why_it_matters: This is a concrete autoresearch demonstration where an agent autonomously recovers provably structured solutions to a hard non-convex optimization problem — directly relevant to researchers interested in AI-driven algorithm discovery and agentic ML.
cards.summary: An AI coding agent was given full authority over architecture, loss function, input/output parameterization, and training recipe for cell-edge power control, a non-convex NP-hard problem. Over 26 hours and 81 experiments, it reached 99.5% of a minorization-maximization reference at roughly 600× lower inference cost, closing 94% of the gap from its first working solution. The discovered output parameterization reproduces the exact max-min-optimal allocation at minimum percentile.

cards.title: Sentence Transformers Adds Full Training Pipeline for ColBERT-Style Multi-Vector Models
cards.why_it_matters: If you build or fine-tune retrieval systems, this gives you a production-ready, single-GPU path to domain-specific multi-vector models that beat all general-purpose retrievers — dense, sparse, lexical, and multi-vector.
cards.summary: Sentence Transformers now ships MultiVectorEncoder with a complete ColBERT-style training stack: loss functions, evaluators, and a Trainer class. A medical model fine-tuned in 14.5 hours on one RTX 3090 outperforms all tested general-purpose retrievers. Key insight: truncation at 180–512 tokens costs up to 0.24 NDCG@10 on long-document domains; custom training lets you configure the right length.
